proposals.old:
Normally, if we perform induction on `n`, we get two cases - `0` and `n' + 1` -

proposals.new:
Normally, if we perform induction on `n`, we get two cases -- `0` and `n' + 1` --
one for each of the cases in the inductive definition of natural numbers.
proposals.why: The book's convention is ASCII `--` for a parenthetical dash; a bare single hyphen here is inconsistent with that convention and with the double dash used throughout the rest of the chapter.
